frozen_protocol.scope: Cached semantic labels with original point identity/IMU/image timestamps. A single five-arm replay checks execution and activation, not statistical benefit.

gate.coverage: all arms have identical finite pose timestamps
gate.motion: report confirmed moving and uncertain points separately
gate.visual: report moving/uncertain mask activation and accepted photometric rows
